# Eleazar

> A Malkavian who lives in Queens, moves house every week, and sometimes talks as though he knows he is a character in someone else's story.

## Appearance

Young-looking, badly shaved, wearing the same brown coat in every season. Eleazar carries a transistor radio that is never switched on.

## Personality

Gentle, distractible, and occasionally, alarmingly, precise. Most of what he says is noise. Some of it is the only true thing anyone says all night.

## Role in Campaign 1

- The city's early warning system for the tunnels: he started having nightmares about Fenwick Street before anyone disappeared.
- A Malkavian player character hears his voice in their dreams before they ever meet him.
- Storyteller only: Eleazar may break the fourth wall and address the player, as the player, once in the chronicle. Use this late, sparingly, and only if the player has already started talking out of character about him.

## Stats (summary)

Eleventh generation; blood pool 12, spends 1 blood per turn. Auspex 3, Dementation 3, Obfuscate 2. Willpower 6, Humanity 7. Derangement: he believes he is being written.
